value.rationale: The natural subset count on a typical fair-sign path is exponential with exponent one-half, giving a motivated reciprocal-activation threshold. The proof completely distinguishes independent Brownian, random-occupation non-Brownian, and eventual pathwise coalescent phases for a fresh parametric family; not a routine finite computation or a restatement of the general covariance criterion.
